gloss_en: addition/increase (tosefet/tosafot) — surplus or excess beyond the essential measure; in Likutey Moharan the aspect of superfluous 'more' (linked to arrogance/idolatry via 'not because of your abundance,' and to the blemish of the covenant as wasted extra). NOT the medieval Talmudic glossators (the Tosafot) nor Sabbath 'tosefet' as a halakhic time-extension term.
